inmostsituations.head: in most situations
inmostsituations.tip: most 后接复数名词，表示大多数情况。

ex.en: In most situations, it is safe.
ex.zh: 在大多数情况下，这是安全的。
ex.note: in most situations 作状语。

ex.en: In most situations, we should stay calm.
ex.zh: 在大多数情况下，我们应保持冷静。
ex.note: should 表示建议。

ex.en: In most situations, he can solve the problem alone.
ex.zh: 在大多数情况下，他能独自解决问题。
ex.note: can 表能力，alone 作状语。

nolonger.head: no longer
nolonger.tip: no longer 常放实义动词前、be 动词后。

ex.en: He is no longer here.
ex.note: no longer 放在 be 动词后。

ex.en: She no longer lives in Beijing.
ex.note: no longer 放在实义动词前。

ex.en: They no longer play football after school.
ex.zh: 他们放学后不再踢足球了。
ex.note: after school 作时间状语。

acceptthelocalculture.head: accept the local culture
acceptthelocalculture.tip: accept 后接名词，local 作定语修饰 culture。

ex.en: We accept the local culture.
ex.note: accept 后接名词作宾语。

ex.en: She accepts the local culture quickly.
ex.zh: 她很快接受了当地文化。
ex.note: accepts 第三人称单数。

ex.en: They accepted the local culture after some time.
ex.zh: 一段时间后他们接受了当地文化。
ex.note: accepted 为过去式，after some time 作状语。

introducesthtosb.head: introduce sth. to sb.
introducesthtosb.forms: introduce的原形/第三人称单数:introduces/过去式:introduced/过去分词:introduced/现在分词:introducing
introducesthtosb.tip: to后接人，宾语顺序不可颠倒。

ex.en: I introduce my friend to you.
ex.zh: 我把我的朋友介绍给你。
ex.note: 基础用法，to后接人。

ex.en: She introduced her new bike to me.
ex.zh: 她把她的新自行车介绍给我。
ex.note: 过去式，to后接人。

ex.en: He is introducing his plan to the class.
ex.zh: 他正在把他的计划介绍给全班。
ex.note: 现在进行时，sth. to sb.结构。

introducesbtosth.head: introduce sb. to sth.
introducesbtosth.forms: introduce的原形/第三人称单数:introduces/过去式:introduced/过去分词:introduced/现在分词:introducing
introducesbtosth.tip: to后接事物，表示使某人了解。

ex.en: Please introduce me to music.
ex.note: 基础用法，to后接事物。

ex.en: She introduced him to Chinese food.
ex.zh: 她让他初次了解中国菜。
ex.note: 过去式，to后接事物。

ex.en: The teacher is introducing us to science.
ex.zh: 老师正在让我们了解科学。
ex.note: 现在进行时，sb. to sth.结构。

invitesbtodosth.head: invite sb. to do sth.
invitesbtodosth.forms: invite的原形/第三人称单数:invites/过去式:invited/过去分词:invited/现在分词:inviting
invitesbtodosth.tip: to do不定式作宾语补足语，不能省略to。

ex.en: I invite him to come.
ex.note: 基础用法，to do结构。

ex.en: She invited me to have dinner.
ex.note: 过去式，to后接动词原形。

ex.en: They are inviting us to join the club.
ex.zh: 他们正在邀请我们加入俱乐部。
ex.note: 现在进行时，invite sb. to do sth.。

expectsbtodosth.head: expect sb. to do sth.
expectsbtodosth.forms: expect的原形/第三人称单数:expects/过去式:expected/过去分词:expected/现在分词:expecting
expectsbtodosth.tip: to do不定式作宾补，表示期待某人做某事。

ex.en: I expect you to win.
ex.note: 基础用法，to do结构。

ex.en: She expected me to call her.
ex.note: 过去式，to后接动词原形。

ex.en: We are expecting him to arrive soon.
ex.note: 现在进行时，expect sb. to do sth.。

begratefulthat.head: be grateful + that
begratefulthat.tip: that后接从句，表示感谢某事。

ex.en: I am grateful that you came.
ex.note: 基础用法，that后接从句。

ex.en: She was grateful that we helped her.
ex.zh: 她很感激我们帮助了她。
ex.note: 过去式was，that后接从句。

ex.en: We are grateful that you are here with us.
ex.zh: 我们很感激你和我们在一起。
ex.note: 现在时are，that从句表感激原因。

atatime.head: at a time
atatime.tip: 表示每次或逐一，常与one连用。

ex.en: Take one at a time.
ex.note: 基础用法，one at a time。

ex.en: Please come in one at a time.
ex.note: 日常情景，逐一进入。

ex.en: She finished the work one step at a time.
ex.zh: 她一步一步地完成了工作。
ex.note: at a time表逐一，逐步进行。

lookdown.head: look down
lookdown.forms: look的原形/第三人称单数:looks/过去式:looked/过去分词:looked/现在分词:looking
lookdown.tip: 后可接at表示向下看某物。

ex.en: Don't look down.
ex.note: 基础用法，祈使句。

ex.en: He looked down at his shoes.
ex.note: 过去式，look down at。

ex.en: She is looking down from the tall building.
ex.note: 现在进行时，from表地点。

sailaway.head: sail away
sailaway.forms: sail的原形/第三人称单数:sails/过去式:sailed/过去分词:sailed/现在分词:sailing

ex.en: The ship sails away.
ex.note: 基础用法，第三人称单数。

ex.en: They sailed away from the island.
ex.zh: 他们驾船离开了那座岛。
ex.note: 过去式，from表离开地点。

ex.en: The boat is sailing away into the sunset.
ex.note: 现在进行时，into表方向。

pullsthinto.head: pull sth. into...
pullsthinto.forms: pull 的形态：原形 pull / 第三人称单数 pulls / 过去式 pulled / 过去分词 pulled / 现在分词 pulling；sth. 随宾语变化
pullsthinto.tip: into 后接地点，宾语放 pull 与 into 之间。

ex.en: Pull it into the box.
ex.note: 基础祈使句，宾语放中间。

ex.en: She pulls the cat into the room.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用 pulls。

ex.en: They pulled the heavy boat into the cave before it rained.
ex.zh: 下雨前他们把重船拉进了山洞。
ex.note: 过去式 pulled，into 表方向。

makesure.head: make sure
makesure.forms: make 的形态：原形 make / 第三人称单数 makes / 过去式 made / 过去分词 made / 现在分词 making
makesure.tip: 后接 that 从句或 of，别漏掉 make 的变化。

ex.en: Make sure.
ex.note: 简短祈使句，语气直接。

ex.en: Please make sure the door is locked.
ex.note: 后接从句，常用一般现在时。

ex.en: She made sure everyone had enough water.
ex.zh: 她确保每个人都有足够的水。
ex.note: 过去式 made，后接过去完成时。

hideinside.head: hide inside
hideinside.forms: hide 的形态：原形 hide / 第三人称单数 hides / 过去式 hid / 过去分词 hidden / 现在分词 hiding；inside 无形态变化
hideinside.tip: hide 后接 inside 表示藏在某物内部。

ex.en: Hide inside.
ex.note: 祈使句，直接表达动作。

ex.en: The cat hides inside the box.
ex.note: 第三人称单数 hides，inside 后接地点。

ex.en: He had hidden inside the old house for two hours.
ex.zh: 他已经在老房子里藏了两个小时。
ex.note: 过去完成时 hidden，强调更早发生。

climbout.head: climb out
climbout.forms: climb 的形态：原形 climb / 第三人称单数 climbs / 过去式 climbed / 过去分词 climbed / 现在分词 climbing；out 无形态变化
climbout.tip: climb out 后常接 of，表示从某处爬出。

ex.en: Climb out.
ex.note: 祈使句，最简表达。

ex.en: The boy climbs out of the window.
ex.note: 第三人称单数 climbs，out of 是常见搭配。

ex.en: They climbed out of the hole and ran away.
ex.zh: 他们从洞里爬出来跑走了。
ex.note: 过去式 climbed，并列动作。

takeover.head: take over
takeover.forms: take 的形态：原形 take / 第三人称单数 takes / 过去式 took / 过去分词 taken / 现在分词 taking；over 无形态变化
takeover.tip: take over 可接宾语，代词放中间。

ex.en: Take over.
ex.note: 祈使句，短促有力。

ex.en: A new manager takes over the team.
ex.zh: 一位新经理接管了这个团队。
ex.note: 第三人称单数 takes，后接宾语。

ex.en: He took over the company after his father retired.
ex.zh: 父亲退休后他接管了公司。
ex.note: 过去式 took，after 引导时间从句。

intheend.head: in the end
intheend.tip: in the end 表最终，不与 at the end 混淆。

ex.en: In the end, we won.
ex.note: 句首作状语，用逗号隔开。

ex.en: He tried many times and in the end he succeeded.
ex.zh: 他试了很多次，最终成功了。
ex.note: 连接前后结果，注意 and 后接句子。

ex.en: In the end, they decided to stay at home.
ex.zh: 最终他们决定待在家里。
ex.note: 后接不定式，表最终决定。

aclevertrick.head: a clever trick
aclevertrick.forms: trick 的名词形态：单数 a clever trick / 复数 clever tricks；clever 的比较级 cleverer 或 more clever，最高级 cleverest 或 most clever
aclevertrick.tip: a clever trick 可数，复数用 clever tricks。

ex.en: It is a clever trick.
ex.note: 主系表结构，冠词 a 不可少。

ex.en: She used a clever trick to open the box.
ex.zh: 她用了一个巧计打开盒子。
ex.note: 不定式表目的，trick 前用 a。

ex.en: They played clever tricks on the enemy.
ex.note: 复数 tricks，play tricks on 是搭配。

arriveat.head: arrive at
arriveat.forms: arrive 的形态：原形 arrive / 第三人称单数 arrives / 过去式 arrived / 过去分词 arrived / 现在分词 arriving
arriveat.tip: arrive at 接小地点，arrive in 接大地点。

ex.en: Arrive at school.
ex.note: 祈使句，at 接小地点。

ex.en: We arrive at the station at eight.
ex.note: 一般现在时表习惯，at 后接具体地点。

ex.en: They arrived at the village after a long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很久后他们到达了村庄。
ex.note: 过去式 arrived，after 表时间先后。

jumpoutof.head: jump out of
jumpoutof.tip: 后接名词或代词，表示从某处跳出。

ex.en: The cat jumps out of the box.
ex.note: 一般现在时，jumps为第三人称单数。

ex.en: He jumped out of the car and ran away.
ex.zh: 他从车里跳出来跑走了。
ex.note: 过去时jumped，描述过去动作。

ex.en: She was so scared that she jumped out of the window.
ex.zh: 她太害怕了，以至于从窗户跳了出去。
ex.note: jumped out of表示从……跳出，注意介词of。

belocatedin.head: be located in
belocatedin.forms: be located in（be动词随主语变化：am/is/are/was/were）
belocatedin.tip: 表示某地坐落于某处，常用被动结构。

ex.en: The school is located in the city.
ex.note: is located in表示位于，主语单数。

ex.en: Our hotel is located in a quiet area.
ex.zh: 我们的酒店位于一个安静的区域。
ex.note: 日常情景，描述位置。

ex.en: The museum was located in the north of the town.
ex.zh: 博物馆曾位于城镇的北部。
ex.note: was located in表示过去位于，注意时态。

atmidnight.head: at midnight
atmidnight.tip: 指午夜十二点，常与具体动作连用。

ex.en: I sleep at midnight.
ex.note: at midnight表示在午夜，介词用at。

ex.en: She often reads at midnight.
ex.note: 一般现在时，表示习惯。

ex.en: We arrived home at midnight after the long trip.
ex.zh: 长途旅行后我们午夜到家。
ex.note: at midnight作时间状语，放句末。

beknownfor.head: be known for
beknownfor.forms: be known for（be动词随主语变化：am/is/are/was/were）
beknownfor.tip: 因某种特点或事物而出名，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: The city is known for its parks.
ex.zh: 这座城市因公园而闻名。
ex.note: is known for后接名词，表示原因。

ex.en: He is known for his kindness.
ex.note: be known for表示以……闻名。

ex.en: The restaurant was known for its delicious food.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆曾以美食闻名。
ex.note: was known for表示过去闻名。

withintendays.head: within ten days
withintendays.tip: 表示在十天之内，强调不超过十天。

ex.en: Finish it within ten days.
ex.note: within ten days表示期限。

ex.en: You will get the book within ten days.
ex.zh: 你将在十天内收到这本书。
ex.note: within ten days常与将来时连用。

ex.en: The work must be done within ten days.
ex.zh: 这项工作必须在十天内完成。
ex.note: 被动语态，within ten days作时间状语。

becomeunderattack.head: be/come under attack
becomeunderattack.forms: be/come under attack（be: am/is/are/was/were; come: come/comes/came/come/coming）
becomeunderattack.tip: 表示遭到攻击，be强调状态，come强调动作。

ex.en: The city is under attack.
ex.note: is under attack表示正在被攻击。

ex.en: The army came under attack at night.
ex.note: came under attack表示遭到攻击。

ex.en: The plan has come under attack from critics.
ex.zh: 该计划受到了批评者的攻击。
ex.note: has come under attack表示已经遭到攻击。

turnstharound.head: turn sth. around
turnstharound.tip: 调转某物方向，代词放turn和around之间。

ex.en: Turn the chair around.
ex.note: 祈使句，turn sth. around。

ex.en: He turned the car around and drove back.
ex.note: turned为过去式，代词放中间。

ex.en: She turned the box around to see the back.
ex.zh: 她把盒子转过来看背面。
ex.note: turned sth. around表示调转方向。

ex.en: I spend an hour reading.
ex.note: spend time doing sth.结构。

ex.en: She spends two hours doing homework every day.
ex.zh: 她每天花两小时做作业。
ex.note: spends为第三人称单数。

ex.en: He spent the whole weekend playing football.
ex.zh: 他整个周末都在踢足球。
ex.note: spent为过去式，后接doing。

succeedindoingsth.head: succeed in (doing) sth.
succeedindoingsth.tip: in后接动名词，不接动词原形。

ex.en: He succeeded in the exam.
ex.note: succeed作不及物动词，接in sth.

ex.en: She succeeded in passing the driving test.
ex.zh: 她成功通过了驾照考试。
ex.note: in后接动名词passing。

ex.en: If you keep trying, you will succeed in reaching your goal.
ex.zh: 如果你坚持努力，你会成功实现目标。
ex.note: will后接原形succeed，体现将来。

pretendtodosth.head: pretend to do sth.
pretendtodosth.tip: pretend后接不定式，不接动名词。

ex.en: He pretends to be happy.
ex.note: pretend后接to be，第三人称单数。

ex.en: She pretended not to see me yesterday.
ex.note: 否定式在to前加not。

ex.en: Don't pretend to know everything when you are not sure.
ex.zh: 不确定时不要假装什么都懂。
ex.note: 否定祈使句，用原形pretend。

beabletodosth.head: be able to do sth.
beabletodosth.forms: be随主语变化：am/is/are/was/were；后接动词原形
beabletodosth.tip: be随人称和时态变化，后接动词原形。

ex.en: I am able to swim.
ex.note: 主语I用am，后接swim原形。

ex.en: She was able to finish the work on time.
ex.zh: 她当时能按时完成工作。
ex.note: 过去式用was able to。

ex.en: Will you be able to come to my party tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你明天能来参加我的聚会吗？
ex.note: 将来时用will be able to。

thankyoufor.head: Thank you for...
thankyoufor.tip: for后接名词或动名词，表示感谢原因。

ex.en: Thank you for your help.
ex.note: for后接名词your help。

ex.en: Thank you for inviting me to dinner.
ex.note: for后接动名词inviting。

ex.en: Thank you for helping me with my English last week.
ex.zh: 谢谢你上周帮我学英语。
ex.note: for后接动名词，表示具体事情。

ex.en: I need to get enough sleep.
ex.note: need to后接get原形。

ex.en: He usually gets enough sleep on weekends.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用gets。

ex.en: If you don't get enough sleep, you may feel tired.
ex.zh: 如果你睡眠不足，可能会感到疲倦。
ex.note: 否定句中用原形get。

exerciseregularly.head: exercise regularly
exerciseregularly.tip: regularly修饰动词，说明锻炼频率。

ex.en: I exercise regularly.
ex.note: 一般现在时，主语I用原形。

ex.en: She exercises regularly to keep healthy.
ex.zh: 她定期锻炼以保持健康。
ex.note: 第三人称单数用exercises。

ex.en: We should exercise regularly instead of sitting all day.
ex.zh: 我们应该定期锻炼，而不是整天坐着。
ex.note: should后接动词原形exercise。

takenotes.head: take notes
takenotes.tip: take notes表示记笔记，常用复数notes。

ex.en: Please take notes in class.
ex.note: 祈使句用原形take。

ex.en: She takes notes carefully every day.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用takes。

ex.en: I took notes while the teacher was explaining.
ex.zh: 老师讲解时我记了笔记。
ex.note: 过去式took，表示过去动作。

improveyourmemory.head: improve your memory
improveyourmemory.tip: improve为及物动词，后接记忆等名词。

ex.en: I want to improve my memory.
ex.note: want to后接improve原形。

ex.en: Reading aloud can improve your memory.
ex.zh: 大声朗读能提高你的记忆力。
ex.note: 情态动词can后接原形。

ex.en: He improved his memory by reviewing every day.
ex.zh: 他通过每天复习提高了记忆力。
ex.note: 过去式improved，说明已完成。

makeupastory.head: make up a story
makeupastory.forms: make 随主语变化：makes/ made/ made/ making；短语整体时态随 make 变化
makeupastory.tip: make up 此处意为“编造”，宾语放中间。

ex.en: I can make up a story.
ex.note: 基础句，情态动词后用原形。

ex.en: She often makes up a story for her brother.
ex.note: 主语第三人称单数，用 makes。

ex.en: He made up a story about the lost dog yesterday.
ex.zh: 他昨天编了一个关于走失小狗的故事。
ex.note: 一般过去时用 made，故事用 about。

aswellas.head: as well as
aswellas.tip: 连接并列成分；作主语时谓语随前者。

ex.en: I like tea as well as coffee.
ex.note: 连接两个名词，位置在中间。

ex.en: She sings as well as dances.
ex.note: 连接两个动词，后接原形。

ex.en: Tom, as well as his friends, is going to the park.
ex.zh: 汤姆和他的朋友们要去公园。
ex.note: 谓语随 Tom，用 is。

what'smore.head: what's more
what'smore.tip: 独立插入语，后加逗号，表递进。

ex.en: It's cheap. What's more, it's useful.
ex.zh: 它很便宜。而且，它很有用。
ex.note: 句子开头作插入语。

ex.en: He is kind. What's more, he works hard.
ex.zh: 他很善良。此外，他工作努力。
ex.note: 补充说明，后接完整句。

ex.en: The plan is good. What's more, it saves time.
ex.zh: 这个计划很好。而且，它还省时间。
ex.note: 常用于写作中表递进。

plentyof.head: plenty of
plentyof.tip: 后接可数复数或不可数名词。

ex.en: We have plenty of time.
ex.note: time 不可数，用 plenty of。

ex.en: There are plenty of books here.
ex.note: books 可数复数，用 are。

ex.en: She has plenty of friends at school.
ex.note: 可数名词复数，谓语用 has。

memoryloss.head: memory loss
memoryloss.tip: 通常不可数；指多次情况可用复数。

ex.en: Memory loss is a problem.
ex.note: 作主语，谓语用单数 is。

ex.en: Old people may have memory loss.
ex.zh: 老年人可能会有记忆力丧失。
ex.note: have 后接不可数名词。

ex.en: Stress can cause memory loss and other problems.
ex.zh: 压力会导致记忆力丧失和其他问题。
ex.note: cause 后接抽象名词，常用搭配。

berelatedtowithsth.head: be related to/with sth.
berelatedtowithsth.forms: be 随主语和时态变化：am/is/are/was/were/been
berelatedtowithsth.tip: 常用 be related to；with 较少见。

ex.en: It is related to me.
ex.note: 主语 it，用 is related to。

ex.en: His illness is related to his diet.
ex.note: 日常情景，用 is related to。

ex.en: These problems were related to the weather last week.
ex.zh: 上周这些问题与天气有关。
ex.note: 过去时复数，用 were related to。

goforapicnic.head: go for a picnic
goforapicnic.tip: go for a picnic，冠词 a 不可少。

ex.en: Let's go for a picnic.
ex.note: 祈使句，go 用原形。

ex.en: We often go for a picnic on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们经常在周日去野餐。
ex.note: 一般现在时，主语 we 用 go。

ex.en: They went for a picnic in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 他们昨天去公园野餐了。
ex.note: 一般过去时用 went，地点用 in。

asummaryof.head: a summary of...
asummaryof.tip: summary 后接 of，表示“……的总结”。

ex.en: This is a summary of the story.
ex.note: 单数 summary，后接 of。

ex.en: Please write a summary of the article.
ex.zh: 请写一篇这篇文章的总结。
ex.note: 日常学习任务，用 a summary of。

ex.en: She gave a summary of the meeting to her class.
ex.zh: 她向全班做了会议总结。
ex.note: give a summary of 为常用搭配。

theconnectionbetween.head: the connection between
theconnectionbetween.tip: between后接两个或以上对象，connection可换为link等

ex.en: The connection between us is strong.
ex.zh: 我们之间的联系很紧密。
ex.note: 基础句型，between后接代词。

ex.en: I see a connection between the two problems.
ex.zh: 我看到这两个问题之间有联系。
ex.note: 日常表达，between连接两个名词。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the connection between diet and health.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究饮食与健康之间的联系。
ex.note: 现在进行时，常见搭配diet and health。

asaresult.head: as a result
asaresult.tip: 常单独作状语，后接结果；接原因用as a result of

ex.en: He was late. As a result, he missed the bus.
ex.zh: 他迟到了。结果，他错过了公交车。
ex.note: 基础用法，as a result后接结果。

ex.en: It rained hard. As a result, we stayed home.
ex.zh: 雨下得很大。结果，我们待在家里。
ex.note: 日常情景，前后需用句号或分号分开。

ex.en: She didn't study. As a result, she failed the exam.
ex.zh: 她没有学习。结果，她考试不及格。
ex.note: 一般过去时，说明因果逻辑。

cutdown.head: cut down
cutdown.forms: 原形cut down/第三人称单数cuts down/过去式cut down/过去分词cut down/现在分词cutting down
cutdown.tip: cut三态同形，cut down可表砍倒或减少

ex.en: They cut down the old tree.
ex.note: 原形/过去式同形，后接宾语。

ex.en: He cuts down trees in the forest every day.
ex.note: 第三人称单数，强调习惯性动作。

ex.en: We must cut down on plastic to protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们必须减少塑料使用以保护环境。
ex.note: cut down on表示减少，常接名词。

arecordof.head: a record of
arecordof.forms: record 的复数：records；a record of 中 a 可换 the 或具体数量
arecordof.tip: record可作名词或动词，注意重音不同

ex.en: This is a record of my daily life.
ex.zh: 这是我日常生活的记录。
ex.note: 基础句型，of后接记录内容。

ex.en: Please keep a record of your spending.
ex.note: 日常情景，keep a record of为固定搭配。

ex.en: The school keeps records of all students' grades.
ex.zh: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
ex.note: 复数records，of后接名词短语。

climatechange.head: climate change
climatechange.tip: 不可数名词短语，作主语时谓语用单数

ex.en: Climate change is a big problem.
ex.note: 基础句型，作主语谓语用单数。

ex.en: Many people worry about climate change.
ex.note: 日常表达，worry about后接名词短语。

ex.en: Climate change has caused serious problems around the world.
ex.zh: 气候变化已在全球引发严重问题。
ex.note: 现在完成时，强调已造成的影响。

eventhough.head: even though
eventhough.tip: 引导让步状语从句，语气比although强

ex.en: Even though it's cold, he goes out.
ex.zh: 即使天冷，他还是出去了。
ex.note: 基础用法，even though后接完整句子。

ex.en: Even though she was tired, she kept working.
ex.zh: 尽管她很累，她还是继续工作。
ex.note: 日常情景，主句用一般过去时。

ex.en: Even though he studied hard, he didn't pass the exam.
ex.zh: 尽管他努力学习，他还是没通过考试。
ex.note: 前后时态一致，注意转折含义。

referto.head: refer to
referto.forms: 原形refer to/第三人称单数refers to/过去式referred to/过去分词referred to/现在分词referring to
referto.tip: refer重读闭音节，过去式双写r；to为介词

ex.en: The word refers to a kind of animal.
ex.zh: 这个词指的是一种动物。
ex.note: 第三人称单数，refer to表示指代。

ex.en: You can refer to the dictionary for new words.
ex.note: 日常情景，refer to表示查阅。

ex.en: He referred to his notes before answering the question.
ex.zh: 他在回答问题前参考了笔记。
ex.note: 过去式referred，双写r，to后接名词。

makesense.head: make sense
makesense.forms: 原形make sense/第三人称单数makes sense/过去式made sense/过去分词made sense/现在分词making sense
makesense.tip: sense不可数，常与make连用，表示讲得通

ex.en: This sentence makes sense.
ex.note: 第三人称单数，主语为单数名词。

ex.en: Your idea doesn't make sense to me.
ex.zh: 你的想法对我来说没道理。
ex.note: 否定形式，to me表示对某人而言。

ex.en: It made sense to save money for the future.
ex.zh: 为将来存钱是有道理的。
ex.note: 过去式made，it作形式主语。

slowdown.head: slowdown
slowdown.tip: 名词，指速度或进度的减缓，常与a连用。

ex.en: There was a slowdown in traffic.
ex.note: 名词作主语，用there be句型。

ex.en: The economic slowdown affected many families.
ex.zh: 经济放缓影响了许多家庭。
ex.note: slowdown前加the，指特定放缓。

ex.en: We have seen a slowdown in the number of new cases recently.
ex.zh: 我们最近看到新增病例数量的减缓。
ex.note: a slowdown in后接名词，表某方面减缓。

makeapointofdoingsth.head: make a point of doing sth.
makeapointofdoingsth.tip: make a point of后必须接动名词，不接不定式。

ex.en: I make a point of saying hello.
ex.note: 一般现在时，后接动名词saying。

ex.en: She makes a point of calling her parents every week.
ex.zh: 她每周都坚持给父母打电话。
ex.note: 第三人称单数用makes，后接calling。

ex.en: He made a point of checking the doors before he left.
ex.zh: 他离开前特意检查了门。
ex.note: 过去式made，后接动名词checking。

tendtodosth.head: tend to do sth.
tendtodosth.tip: tend to后接动词原形，表示常常或易于做。

ex.en: I tend to sleep early.
ex.note: tend to后接动词原形sleep。

ex.en: She tends to forget names.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用tends，后接forget。

ex.en: People tend to eat more when they are happy.
ex.zh: 人们开心时往往会吃得更多。
ex.note: tend to后接eat，主句表普遍倾向。

it'snormalforsbtodosth.head: It's normal (for sb.) to do sth.
it'snormalforsbtodosth.forms: be动词随主语和时态变化；to后接动词原形
it'snormalforsbtodosth.tip: It是形式主语，真正主语是to do不定式。

ex.en: It's normal to feel tired.
ex.note: It's normal后接to do，形式主语。

ex.en: It's normal for students to make mistakes.
ex.note: for students说明对谁而言正常。

ex.en: It was normal for him to arrive late.
ex.note: 过去时was，for him说明对象。

keepondoingsth.head: keep (on) doing sth.
keepondoingsth.tip: keep后接动名词，不接不定式，on可省略。

ex.en: Keep smiling.
ex.note: 祈使句，keep后接动名词smiling。

ex.en: She keeps asking questions.
ex.note: 第三人称单数keeps，后接asking。

ex.en: He kept on working although he was tired.
ex.zh: 尽管累了，他仍继续工作。
ex.note: 过去式kept，keep on doing表继续。

ex.en: No wonder you are tired.
ex.note: 省略It's，直接说No wonder。

ex.en: It's no wonder that she passed the exam.
ex.note: 完整结构It's no wonder that。

ex.en: No wonder he was late; the traffic was terrible.
ex.zh: 难怪他迟到了，交通太糟糕了。
ex.note: 后接原因句，用分号连接。

itishelpfulto.head: It is helpful to...
itishelpfulto.forms: be动词随时态变化；to后接动词原形
itishelpfulto.tip: It是形式主语，to do是真正主语。

ex.en: It is helpful to read.
ex.note: It is helpful后接to read。

ex.en: It is helpful to ask your teacher for help.
ex.zh: 向老师求助是有帮助的。
ex.note: to ask后接宾语，说明具体做法。

ex.en: It was helpful to review the notes before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前复习笔记是有帮助的。
ex.note: 过去时was，to review表具体行为。

keeppets.head: keep pets
keeppets.tip: keep pets表示养宠物，pets用复数。

ex.en: I keep pets.
ex.note: keep pets，pets用复数表类别。

ex.en: She keeps two pets at home.
ex.note: 第三人称单数keeps，数量后接复数。

ex.en: Many families keep pets for company.
ex.note: keep pets for company，表目的。

holdinone'sarms.head: hold ... in one's arms
holdinone'sarms.forms: hold 的变化：原形 hold / 第三人称单数 holds / 过去式 held / 过去分词 held / 现在分词 holding
holdinone'sarms.tip: one's 随主语变化；宾语放 hold 与 in 之间。

ex.en: She holds the baby in her arms.
ex.note: 一般现在时，one's 用 her。

ex.en: He held the little dog in his arms.
ex.note: 过去式 held，宾语在 hold 后。

ex.en: The mother was holding her sleeping son in her arms.
ex.zh: 母亲正把熟睡的儿子抱在怀里。
ex.note: 过去进行时，体现 holding 形态。

learnfrom.head: learn ... from ...
learnfrom.forms: learn 的变化：原形 learn / 第三人称单数 learns / 过去式 learned 或 learnt / 过去分词 learned 或 learnt / 现在分词 learning
learnfrom.tip: from 后接人或事物；learn 后接所学内容。

ex.en: We learn English from Ms. Li.
ex.note: 一般现在时，learn 后接内容。

ex.en: I learned a lot from my friends.
ex.zh: 我从朋友那里学到了很多。
ex.note: 过去式 learned，from 后接人。

ex.en: She has learned how to be brave from her father.
ex.zh: 她从父亲那里学会了如何勇敢。
ex.note: 现在完成时，learn from 搭配。

careforlookaftertakecareof.head: care for
careforlookaftertakecareof.forms: care 的变化：原形 care / 第三人称单数 cares / 过去式 cared / 过去分词 cared / 现在分词 caring；同义短语 look after、take care of
careforlookaftertakecareof.tip: care for 较正式；take care of 更口语常用。

ex.en: She cares for her cat.
ex.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数 cares。

ex.en: I care for my grandma on weekends.
ex.note: care for 相当于 look after。

ex.en: He has cared for the old man for three years.
ex.zh: 他已经照顾那位老人三年了。
ex.note: 现在完成时，for 接时间段。

barkat.head: bark at
barkat.forms: bark 的变化：原形 bark / 第三人称单数 barks / 过去式 barked / 过去分词 barked / 现在分词 barking
barkat.tip: at 后接吠叫的对象；狗常作主语。

ex.en: The dog barks at me.
ex.note: 一般现在时，第三人称单数 barks。

ex.en: My dog barked at the stranger.
ex.note: 过去式 barked，at 后接对象。

ex.en: The dog was barking at the mailman when I left.
ex.zh: 我离开时，那只狗正朝邮递员吠叫。
ex.note: 过去进行时，体现 barking。

atleast.head: at least
atleast.tip: 常用于数量前；反义为 at most。

ex.en: There are at least ten books.
ex.note: at least 后接数量。

ex.en: You should sleep at least eight hours.
ex.zh: 你应该至少睡八个小时。
ex.note: 表示最低限度。

ex.en: At least, we can try our best.
ex.zh: 至少我们可以尽力而为。
ex.note: 句首作状语，语气稍弱。

onone'sown.head: on one's own
onone'sown.forms: one's 随主语变化，如 on my own、on your own、on his own
onone'sown.tip: 相当于 alone，但更强调独立完成。

ex.en: I am on my own.
ex.note: one's 随主语变成 my。

ex.en: She does her homework on her own.
ex.note: 强调独立完成。

ex.en: He learned to cook on his own last year.
ex.zh: 去年他独自学会了做饭。
ex.note: one's 用 his，搭配 learn to。

onthewhole.head: on the whole
onthewhole.tip: 整体评价时用，常放句首或句末。

ex.en: On the whole, it is good.
ex.note: 句首作状语。

ex.en: The trip was fun on the whole.
ex.zh: 总的来说，这次旅行很有趣。
ex.note: 句末使用，评价整体。

ex.en: On the whole, students did well in the exam.
ex.zh: 总体而言，学生们考试考得不错。
ex.note: 用于总结整体情况。

theotherday.head: the other day
theotherday.tip: 只用于过去时，意为前几天。

ex.en: I saw him the other day.
ex.note: 搭配过去式 saw。

ex.en: The other day, we went to the park.
ex.note: 句首作时间状语。

ex.en: She met her old friend the other day and they talked for hours.
ex.zh: 前几天她遇到了老朋友，他们聊了几个小时。
ex.note: 用于过去时，后面可接并列句。

behappydoingsth.head: be happy doing sth.
behappydoingsth.forms: be动词随主语变化: am/is/are; was/were

ex.en: I am happy reading books.
ex.note: be happy后接doing形式。

ex.en: She is happy helping her mother.
ex.note: 主语第三人称用is。

ex.en: They were happy working together last year.
ex.zh: 他们去年乐意一起工作。
ex.note: 过去时用were，后接doing。

thousandsof.head: thousands of
thousandsof.tip: 后接可数名词复数，前不加具体数字。

ex.en: Thousands of birds fly south.
ex.zh: 数以千计的鸟飞往南方。
ex.note: thousands of后接复数名词。

ex.en: There are thousands of people in the park.
ex.zh: 公园里有数以千计的人。
ex.note: 表数量多，用复数动词。

ex.en: Thousands of students have joined the club.
ex.zh: 数以千计的学生加入了俱乐部。
ex.note: 现在完成时表已有结果。

ex.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
ex.note: a symbol of固定搭配。

ex.en: This ring is a symbol of our love.
ex.zh: 这枚戒指是我们爱情的象征。
ex.note: of后接抽象名词。

ex.en: Red lanterns are symbols of good luck in China.
ex.zh: 红灯笼在中国是好运的象征。
ex.note: 多个象征时用symbols。

catchtheeyeofsb.head: catch the eye of sb.
catchtheeyeofsb.tip: sb.可换为形容词性物主代词。

ex.en: The red dress catches my eye.
ex.zh: 那条红裙子引起我的注意。
ex.note: catch one's eye常用现在时。

ex.en: Her smile caught the eye of the teacher.
ex.zh: 她的微笑引起了老师的注意。
ex.note: 过去式caught表已发生。

ex.en: The bright sign is catching the eye of many visitors.
ex.zh: 这个亮眼的标志正引起许多游客的注意。
ex.note: 现在进行时表正在吸引。

takeprideinbeproudof.head: take pride in
takeprideinbeproudof.forms: take: takes/took/taken/taking; 同义 be proud of

ex.en: I take pride in my school.
ex.note: take pride in后接名词。

ex.en: She takes pride in helping others.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用takes。

ex.en: We took pride in our team's success.
ex.zh: 我们为团队的成功感到骄傲。
ex.note: 过去式took表曾骄傲。

bearinmindkeepinmind.head: bear in mind
bearinmindkeepinmind.forms: bear: bears/bore/borne/bearing; 同义 keep in mind

ex.en: Bear in mind the rules.
ex.note: 祈使句用动词原形。

ex.en: Please keep in mind that time is important.
ex.note: 后接that从句。

ex.en: I have borne your advice in mind.
ex.zh: 我已把你的建议记在心上。
ex.note: 现在完成时用borne。

it'sagoodideatodosth.head: it's a good idea to do sth.
it'sagoodideatodosth.tip: it是形式主语，真正主语是to do。

ex.en: It's a good idea to walk.
ex.note: it作形式主语，to do后置。

ex.en: It's a good idea to drink more water.
ex.note: to do表具体动作。

ex.en: It's a good idea to read English every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上读英语是个好主意。
ex.note: 可加频率状语，to do不变。

bepleasedtodosth.head: be pleased to do sth.
bepleasedtodosth.forms: be动词随主语变化: am/is/are; was/were

ex.en: I am pleased to meet you.
ex.note: be pleased to do固定用法。

ex.en: She is pleased to help us.
ex.note: 主语第三人称用is。

ex.en: They were pleased to hear the good news.
ex.zh: 听到好消息他们很高兴。
ex.note: 过去时were，to do不变。

advisesbnottodosth.head: advise sb. (not) to do sth.
advisesbnottodosth.forms: 动词 advise：advises/advised/advised/advising；后接 sb. to do 或 sb. not to do
advisesbnottodosth.tip: advise 后不接 sb. do，否定式为 not to do。

ex.en: I advise you to rest.
ex.note: advise sb. to do 基础结构。

ex.en: The doctor advised him not to smoke.
ex.note: 否定用 not to do，放在 sb. 后。

ex.en: She has advised us to leave early many times.
ex.zh: 她多次建议我们早点离开。
ex.note: 现在完成时体现 advise 的过去分词。

it'scommonforsbtodosth.head: It's common for sb. to do sth.
it'scommonforsbtodosth.forms: 无形态变化；it 为形式主语，真正主语是 to do 短语
it'scommonforsbtodosth.tip: for 后接人，to do 是真正主语。

ex.en: It's common to be late.
ex.note: 省略 for sb. 也可成立。

ex.en: It's common for students to feel tired.
ex.note: for students 表明动作执行者。

ex.en: It's common for people to check their phones in the morning.
ex.zh: 人们早上看手机很常见。
ex.note: It's common for sb. to do 完整结构。

havenochoicebuttodosth.head: have no choice but to do sth.
havenochoicebuttodosth.forms: 动词 have：has/had/had/having；but 后固定接 to do
havenochoicebuttodosth.tip: but 后接 to do，不能省略 to。

ex.en: I have no choice but to go.
ex.note: have no choice but to do 固定搭配。

ex.en: We had no choice but to wait.
ex.zh: 我们别无选择，只能等待。
ex.note: 过去式 had 体现时态变化。

ex.en: He has no choice but to accept the result.
ex.zh: 他别无选择，只能接受结果。
ex.note: 第三人称单数用 has。

seemtodosth.head: seem to do sth.
seemtodosth.forms: 动词 seem：seems/seemed/seemed/seeming；后接 to do
seemtodosth.tip: seem to do 表示似乎做某事。

ex.en: He seems to know me.
ex.note: seems to do 基础结构。

ex.en: She seemed to be tired yesterday.
ex.note: seemed to be 表示过去状态。

ex.en: They seem to have finished the work.
ex.zh: 他们似乎已经完成了工作。
ex.note: seem to have done 表示动作已完成。

it'sunlikelythat.head: It's unlikely that...
it'sunlikelythat.forms: 无形态变化；that 后接完整句子
it'sunlikelythat.tip: unlikely 后接 that 从句，不接 to do 时需注意。

ex.en: It's unlikely that he comes.
ex.note: that 后接完整句子。

ex.en: It's unlikely that we will win.
ex.note: will 表示将来不太可能。

ex.en: It's unlikely that she has finished so quickly.
ex.zh: 她不太可能这么快就完成了。
ex.note: 现在完成时表示对已发生情况的推测。

havetheabilitytodosth.head: have the ability to do sth.
havetheabilitytodosth.forms: 动词 have：has/had/had/having；ability 复数 abilities
havetheabilitytodosth.tip: ability 后接 to do，不接 doing。

ex.en: I have the ability to swim.
ex.note: have the ability to do 基础结构。

ex.en: She has the ability to solve problems.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用 has。

ex.en: They had the ability to work under pressure.
ex.zh: 他们有能力在压力下工作。
ex.note: 过去式 had 体现时态变化。

moveontodoingsth.head: move on to (doing) sth.
moveontodoingsth.forms: 动词 move：moves/moved/moved/moving；on 为副词，to 后接名词或动名词
moveontodoingsth.tip: move on to 后接下一步要做的事。

ex.en: Let's move on to math.
ex.note: move on to 后接名词。

ex.en: After reading, we moved on to writing.
ex.zh: 读完后，我们接着开始写。
ex.note: moved on to 后接动名词。

ex.en: She has moved on to a new project.
ex.zh: 她已经转而开始一个新项目。
ex.note: 现在完成时体现 move 的过去分词。

intelligence.head: intelligence
intelligence.forms: 名词 intelligence 不可数；形容词 intelligent：more intelligent/most intelligent
intelligence.tip: intelligence 常不可数，形容词是 intelligent。

ex.en: He has high intelligence.
ex.note: intelligence 作不可数名词。

ex.en: She is an intelligent student.
ex.note: intelligent 作形容词修饰名词。

ex.en: Artificial intelligence is changing our lives.
ex.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的生活。
ex.note: intelligence 常见搭配 artificial intelligence。

talent.head: talent
talent.tip: talent 作"天赋"常不可数，作"人才"可数。

ex.en: She has a talent for music.
ex.note: talent 常与 for 连用，表示某方面的天赋。

ex.en: The young talent is very popular at school.
ex.zh: 这位年轻才俊在学校很受欢迎。
ex.note: 这里 talent 指"人才"，是可数名词。

ex.en: His talent for drawing made him a talented artist later.
ex.zh: 他的绘画天赋使他后来成为一位有才华的艺术家。
ex.note: talented 是形容词，修饰 artist 作定语。

art.head: art
art.tip: art 作"艺术"常不可数，作"美术作品"可复数。

ex.en: I love art.
ex.note: art 表示抽象"艺术"概念时不可数。

ex.en: She wants to be an artist.
ex.note: artist 是与 art 对应的表示人的名词。

ex.en: The museum shows many works of art by famous artistic talents.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了许多著名艺术天才的艺术作品。
ex.note: artistic 作形容词修饰 talents，表示"有艺术天赋的"。

prehistory.head: prehistory
prehistory.tip: prehistory 是不可数名词，通常不加冠词。

ex.en: We study prehistory.
ex.note: prehistory 作学科名称，前不用冠词。

ex.en: Dinosaurs lived in prehistory.
ex.note: in prehistory 表示"在史前时期"。

ex.en: Prehistoric people made tools from stone.
ex.zh: 史前人类用石头制作工具。
ex.note: prehistoric 作形容词，修饰 people。

complete.head: complete
complete.forms: 比较级 more complete；最高级 most complete
complete.tip: complete 作形容词时无比较级变化，但可用 more/most。

ex.en: The work is complete.
ex.note: complete 作形容词表示"完整的"。

ex.en: She completely forgot my name.
ex.note: completely 是副词，修饰动词 forgot。

ex.en: We need to check the completeness of the report.
ex.zh: 我们需要检查报告的完整性。
ex.note: completeness 是名词，表示"完整（性）"。

suffer.head: suffer
suffer.forms: 原形 suffer / 第三人称单数 suffers / 过去式 suffered / 过去分词 suffered / 现在分词 suffering
suffer.tip: suffer 后常接 from，表示"患……病"或"受……之苦"。

ex.en: He suffers from headaches.
ex.note: suffers 是第三人称单数，常与 from 连用。

ex.en: Many people suffered during the war.
ex.note: suffered 是过去式，表示过去遭受痛苦。

ex.en: Her suffering made us all very sad.
ex.zh: 她的痛苦让我们都很难过。
ex.note: suffering 作名词，表示"痛苦、苦难"。

die.head: die
die.forms: 原形 die / 第三人称单数 dies / 过去式 died / 过去分词 died / 现在分词 dying
die.tip: die 是动词，表示"死"；dead 是形容词，表示"死的"。

ex.en: His dog died.
ex.note: died 是过去式，作谓语。

ex.en: The old man is dead.
ex.note: dead 是形容词，作表语表示状态。

ex.en: The battery is dead, so the phone can't work.
ex.zh: 电池没电了，所以手机不能工作。
ex.note: dead 也可形容设备"不运行的、没电的"。

edit.head: edit
edit.forms: 原形 edit / 第三人称单数 edits / 过去式 edited / 过去分词 edited / 现在分词 editing
edit.tip: edit 是及物动词，后接被编辑的对象。

ex.en: She edits a newspaper.
ex.note: edits 是第三人称单数形式。

ex.en: He edited the video last night.
ex.note: edited 是过去式，表示过去的动作。

ex.en: The editor is editing the book now.
ex.note: editor 是名词"编辑"；editing 是现在分词。

relate.head: relate
relate.forms: 原形 relate / 第三人称单数 relates / 过去式 related / 过去分词 related / 现在分词 relating
relate.tip: relate 常与 to 连用；related 是形容词，表示"相关的"。

ex.en: I can relate to that.
ex.note: relate to 表示"理解、认同"。

ex.en: The two events are related.
ex.note: related 是形容词，作表语。

ex.en: She related her story to the police.
ex.zh: 她向警方讲述了自己的经历。
ex.note: relate 作动词，表示"讲述"，后接 to sb。

general.head: general
general.forms: 比较级 more general；最高级 most general
general.tip: general指总体或一般，不指具体细节。

ex.en: This is a general rule.
ex.note: 基础用法，general作定语修饰rule。

ex.en: In general, I get up early.
ex.note: 固定短语in general表示通常。

ex.en: The general idea is clear, but the details are not.
ex.zh: 总体思路很清楚，但细节还不清楚。
ex.note: general与details对比，体现总体含义。

educate.head: educate
educate.forms: 原形 educate / 第三人称单数 educates / 过去式 educated / 过去分词 educated / 现在分词 educating
educate.tip: educate强调教育培养，比teach更正式。

ex.en: Teachers educate students.
ex.note: 原形作谓语，主语复数。

ex.en: She educates children in a small school.
ex.zh: 她在一所小学校教育孩子。
ex.note: 第三人称单数educates，注意主语she。

ex.en: He was educated in London and became an educator.
ex.zh: 他在伦敦受教育，后来成了教育家。
ex.note: 被动语态educated，后接became体现变化。

long.head: long
long.forms: 比较级 longer；最高级 longest
long.tip: long指长度或时间，问长度用How long。

ex.en: This ruler is long.
ex.note: long作表语，说明尺子长度。

ex.en: The river is longer than that one.
ex.note: 比较级longer，后接than。

ex.en: How long is the Great Wall? It is about 21,000 kilometres in length.
ex.zh: 长城有多长？它大约长两万一千公里。
ex.note: 问长度用How long，length是名词。

similar.head: similar
similar.forms: 比较级 more similar；最高级 most similar

ex.en: These two pens are similar.
ex.note: similar作表语，说明两者相像。

ex.en: My bag is similar to yours.
ex.note: 固定搭配be similar to，不用with。

ex.en: There are many similarities between the two cities, and they look similarly beautiful.
ex.zh: 这两座城市有很多相似之处，它们看起来同样美丽。
ex.note: similarity是名词，similarly修饰beautiful。

alphabet.head: alphabet
alphabet.tip: alphabet指字母表，字母顺序是alphabetical order。

ex.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
ex.zh: 英语字母表里有26个字母。
ex.note: 基础表达，alphabet作单数名词。

ex.en: Please put these words in alphabetical order.
ex.zh: 请把这些单词按字母顺序排列。
ex.note: alphabetical order是常用搭配。

ex.en: The names are listed alphabetically, so you can find yours quickly.
ex.zh: 名字按字母顺序列出，所以你能很快找到你的。
ex.note: alphabetically是副词，修饰listed。

play.head: play
play.forms: 原形 play / 第三人称单数 plays / 过去式 played / 过去分词 played / 现在分词 playing
play.tip: play后接球类不加the，接乐器常加the。

ex.en: They play football.
ex.note: play后接球类，不加the。

ex.en: She plays the piano every day.
ex.note: play后接乐器，常用the。

ex.en: The player played happily and showed a playful smile.
ex.zh: 那名运动员开心地玩耍，露出顽皮的笑容。
ex.note: player和playful均由play派生。

important.head: important
important.forms: 比较级 more important；最高级 most important
important.tip: important作表语时，常用It is important to do。

ex.en: This book is important.
ex.note: important作表语，说明书重要。

ex.en: It is important to eat breakfast.
ex.note: 固定句型It is important to do。

ex.en: Health is of great importance, and more importantly, we should sleep well.
ex.zh: 健康非常重要，更重要的是，我们应该睡好。
ex.note: importance是名词，importantly作副词。

hesitate.head: hesitate
hesitate.forms: 原形 hesitate / 第三人称单数 hesitates / 过去式 hesitated / 过去分词 hesitated / 现在分词 hesitating
hesitate.tip: hesitate后接to do，表示犹豫做某事。

ex.en: Don't hesitate.
ex.note: 祈使句否定式，直接使用原形。

ex.en: She hesitates to ask questions in class.
ex.zh: 她在课上犹豫着不敢提问。
ex.note: 第三人称单数hesitates，后接to do。

ex.en: He hesitated for a moment, but finally made the decision without hesitation.
ex.zh: 他犹豫了一会儿，但最终毫不犹豫地做了决定。
ex.note: hesitated是过去式，hesitation是名词。

current.head: current
current.forms: 比较级 more current，最高级 most current
current.tip: current作形容词指“当前的”，副词currently表“目前”。

ex.en: This is the current price.
ex.note: current作定语，修饰名词price。

ex.en: The current weather is very cold.
ex.note: current描述现在的情况，位置在名词前。

ex.en: She is currently working in Beijing.
ex.note: currently作副词，常与进行时连用。

sharp.head: sharp
sharp.forms: 比较级 sharper，最高级 sharpest；动词 sharpen 的变化：原形 sharpen/第三人称单数 sharpens/过去式 sharpened/过去分词 sharpened/现在分词 sharpening；副词 sharply
sharp.tip: sharp指“锋利的”，sharpen是动词“使变锋利”。

ex.en: The knife is sharp.
ex.note: sharp作表语，描述刀的特征。

ex.en: Be careful with that sharp edge.
ex.note: sharp作定语，修饰edge。

ex.en: He sharpened the pencil before class.
ex.zh: 上课前他把铅笔削尖了。
ex.note: sharpen的过去式sharpened，表过去动作。

exact.head: exact
exact.forms: 比较级 more exact，最高级 most exact；副词 exactly
exact.tip: exact强调“完全准确”，exactly常用来回答或强调。

ex.en: The exact time is 3:00.
ex.note: exact作定语，修饰time。

ex.en: I need the exact number.
ex.note: exact描述number，表示准确无误。

ex.en: That is exactly what I mean.
ex.note: exactly作副词，强调事实完全一致。

price.head: price
price.forms: 复数 prices；形容词 pricey 比较级 pricier，最高级 priciest；priceless 无比较级

ex.en: The price is too high.
ex.note: price作主语，后接be动词。

ex.en: I checked the prices online.
ex.note: prices用复数，指多种商品价格。

ex.en: This watch is pricey but priceless to me.
ex.zh: 这块表很贵，但对我而言无价。
ex.note: pricey表昂贵，priceless表无价。

tag.head: tag
tag.forms: 复数 tags；动词变化：原形 tag/第三人称单数 tags/过去式 tagged/过去分词 tagged/现在分词 tagging
tag.tip: tag可作名词“标签”，也可作动词“贴标签”。

ex.en: This tag has a name on it.
ex.note: tag作名词，指标签。

ex.en: Please tag your bags.
ex.note: tag作动词，后接宾语bags。

ex.en: She tagged all the boxes yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天给所有箱子都贴了标签。
ex.note: tagged是过去式，表示昨天完成的动作。

moment.head: moment
moment.forms: 复数 moments；形容词 momentary 无比较级

ex.en: Wait a moment, please.
ex.note: a moment表示很短的时间。

ex.en: I saw her a moment ago.
ex.note: a moment ago用于一般过去时。

ex.en: There was a momentary pause.
ex.note: momentary作定语，表瞬间的。

pay.head: pay
pay.forms: 动词变化：原形 pay/第三人称单数 pays/过去式 paid/过去分词 paid/现在分词 paying；名词 payment 复数 payments
pay.tip: pay的过去式和过去分词都是paid，payment是名词。

ex.en: I pay for my lunch.
ex.note: pay for表示“为……付款”。

ex.en: She paid ten dollars for the book.
ex.zh: 她花十美元买了这本书。
ex.note: paid是过去式，后接金额。

ex.en: He has paid the bill already.
ex.note: paid是过去分词，用于现在完成时。

treat.head: treat
treat.forms: 动词变化：原形 treat/第三人称单数 treats/过去式 treated/过去分词 treated/现在分词 treating；名词 treatment 复数 treatments
treat.tip: treat作动词“对待”，treatment是名词“对待”。

ex.en: Treat others kindly.
ex.note: treat作动词，后接宾语others。

ex.en: She treats her dog well.
ex.note: treats是第三人称单数，后接宾语。

ex.en: He treated us to dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚他请我们吃了晚饭。
ex.note: treated是过去式，treat sb to sth表示请客。

smooth.head: smooth
smooth.forms: 比较级 smoother，最高级 smoothest
smooth.tip: smooth 指表面或过程顺利；副词 smoothly 常修饰工作、进行等。

ex.en: The road is smooth.
ex.note: be 动词后接形容词 smooth 作表语。

ex.en: Her skin feels very smooth.
ex.zh: 她的皮肤摸起来很光滑。
ex.note: feel 后接形容词，不用 smoothly。

ex.en: The meeting went smoothly yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天会议进行得很顺利。
ex.note: 修饰动词 went 用副词 smoothly。

weigh.head: weigh
weigh.forms: 原形 weigh / 第三人称单数 weighs / 过去式 weighed / 过去分词 weighed / 现在分词 weighing
weigh.tip: weigh 作动词表称重；weight 是名词，注意别混用。

ex.en: I weigh 50 kilos.
ex.note: weigh 后直接接重量，不用 be。

ex.en: She weighs the apples every morning.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用 weighs。

ex.en: He weighed the box and wrote down its weight.
ex.zh: 他称了箱子并写下它的重量。
ex.note: weighed 是过去式；weight 是名词。

social.head: social
social.forms: 比较级 more social，最高级 most social
social.tip: social 是形容词；society 是名词，注意词性不同。

ex.en: He has many social activities.
ex.note: social 修饰名词 activities。

ex.en: Social life is important for students.
ex.zh: 社交生活对学生很重要。
ex.note: social 作定语，说明生活类型。

ex.en: Our society needs more social workers.
ex.zh: 我们的社会需要更多社会工作者。
ex.note: society 是名词，social 是形容词。

base.head: base
base.tip: base 指具体根基；basis 多指抽象基础，basic 是形容词。

ex.en: The base is strong.
ex.note: base 作名词，指具体底部。

ex.en: We set up a base near the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边建立了一个基地。
ex.note: base 可指活动基地。

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship, and it is basic.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础，而且它很基本。
ex.note: basis 抽象基础；basic 作形容词。

electron.head: electron
electron.tip: electron 是名词电子；electronic 是形容词电子的。

ex.en: An electron is very small.
ex.note: electron 作主语，单数用 an。

ex.en: This picture shows how electrons move.
ex.zh: 这张图显示电子如何运动。
ex.note: 复数 electrons 表示多个电子。

ex.en: Electronic games use electrons in circuits.
ex.zh: 电子游戏在电路中使用电子。
ex.note: electronic 是形容词，修饰 games。

connect.head: connect
connect.forms: 原形 connect / 第三人称单数 connects / 过去式 connected / 过去分词 connected / 现在分词 connecting
connect.tip: connect A to/with B 表示连接；名词 connection 更常指联系。

ex.en: Please connect the two wires.
ex.note: connect 后接宾语，表示连接。

ex.en: This road connects our town to the city.
ex.zh: 这条路把我们镇和城市连起来。
ex.note: connect A to B 是常见搭配。

ex.en: He connected the printer, and the connection worked.
ex.zh: 他连接了打印机，连接成功了。
ex.note: connected 是过去式；connection 是名词。

big.head: big
big.forms: 比较级 bigger，最高级 biggest
big.tip: big 的比较级和最高级要双写 g，再加 -er/-est。

ex.en: This bag is big.
ex.note: big 作表语，说明大小。

ex.en: My room is bigger than yours.
ex.note: bigger 是 big 的比较级。

ex.en: It is the biggest park in our city.
ex.zh: 它是我们城市里最大的公园。
ex.note: biggest 前常加 the，表最高级。

change.head: change
change.forms: 原形 change / 第三人称单数 changes / 过去式 changed / 过去分词 changed / 现在分词 changing
change.tip: change 可作动词改变；changeable 是形容词，变化无常的。

ex.en: I change my shoes.
ex.note: change 作动词，后接宾语。

ex.en: The weather changes quickly here.
ex.note: 第三人称单数用 changes。

ex.en: He changed his plan because the weather is changeable.
ex.zh: 因为天气变化无常，他改变了计划。
ex.note: changed 是过去式；changeable 是形容词。

example.head: example
example.tip: for example 后接例子，不加逗号隔开句子。

ex.en: This is an example.
ex.note: an 用于元音音素开头的词。

ex.en: Can you give me an example?
ex.note: give an example 是常见搭配。

ex.en: For example, many students learn English by watching films.
ex.zh: 例如，许多学生通过看电影学英语。
ex.note: for example 引出具体例子，后加逗号。

person.head: person
person.forms: 复数 people 或 persons（正式）
person.tip: 日常复数用 people，法律文书中用 persons。

ex.en: He is a good person.
ex.note: 单数 person 指一个人。

ex.en: She is a very kind person.
ex.zh: 她是一个非常善良的人。
ex.note: kind person 是常见搭配。

ex.en: Many people think personal time is important.
ex.zh: 许多人认为个人时间很重要。
ex.note: people 是 person 的常用复数。

centre.head: centre
centre.forms: 复数 centres；美式拼写 center
centre.tip: 英式拼写 centre，美式为 center，注意区分。

ex.en: The shop is in the centre.
ex.note: in the centre 表示在中心位置。

ex.en: We met at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心见面了。
ex.note: shopping centre 是常见地点名词。

ex.en: The central park is in the centre of the city.
ex.note: central 是 centre 的形容词形式。

predict.head: predict
predict.forms: 原形 predict / 第三人称单数 predicts / 过去式 predicted / 过去分词 predicted / 现在分词 predicting
predict.tip: predict 后常接名词或 that 从句，表示预测。

ex.en: I predict rain.
ex.note: predict 后可直接接名词。

ex.en: Can you predict the result?
ex.note: predict the result 是常见搭配。

ex.en: Scientists have predicted that the weather will change.
ex.zh: 科学家已经预测天气将会变化。
ex.note: predict that 从句用将来时。

state.head: state
state.forms: 动词：原形 state / 第三人称单数 states / 过去式 stated / 过去分词 stated / 现在分词 stating；名词：复数 states
state.tip: state 作动词是陈述，作名词是状态或州。

ex.en: Please state your name.
ex.note: state 作动词，后接宾语。

ex.en: He stated his opinion clearly.
ex.zh: 他清楚地陈述了自己的观点。
ex.note: stated 是过去式，表示已陈述。

ex.en: The report states that the state is in good condition.
ex.zh: 报告陈述该州状况良好。
ex.note: states 作动词；state 作名词指州或状态。

mix.head: mix
mix.forms: 原形 mix / 第三人称单数 mixes / 过去式 mixed / 过去分词 mixed / 现在分词 mixing
mix.tip: mix 后接 with 表示与……混合。

ex.en: Mix the eggs.
ex.note: mix 是祈使句，直接加宾语。

ex.en: Mix the flour with water.
ex.note: mix A with B 是固定搭配。

ex.en: She mixed the colours and made a beautiful picture.
ex.zh: 她混合了颜色，画出了一幅美丽的画。
ex.note: mixed 是过去式，表示已混合。

trade.head: trade
trade.forms: 原形 trade / 第三人称单数 trades / 过去式 traded / 过去分词 traded / 现在分词 trading
trade.tip: trade 作动词常接 with，表示与……贸易。

ex.en: They trade goods.
ex.note: trade 后接货物作宾语。

ex.en: Our country trades with many nations.
ex.zh: 我国与许多国家进行贸易。
ex.note: trade with 表示与某方贸易。

ex.en: The trader traded his goods for money.
ex.note: trader 是 trade 的名词形式，指商人。

print.head: print
print.forms: 原形 print / 第三人称单数 prints / 过去式 printed / 过去分词 printed / 现在分词 printing
print.tip: print 作动词是打印，printer 是打印机。

ex.en: Please print this page.
ex.note: print 后接要打印的内容。

ex.en: The printer can print 20 pages a minute.
ex.zh: 这台打印机每分钟能打印20页。
ex.note: printer 是 print 的名词形式。

ex.en: He printed the document and gave it to the teacher.
ex.zh: 他打印了文件并交给了老师。
ex.note: printed 是过去式，表示已打印。

fun.head: fun
fun.tip: fun是不可数名词，不能说a fun或funs。

ex.en: We had fun.
ex.note: fun作不可数名词，前面不加a。

ex.en: The party is great fun.
ex.note: great fun表示“很大的乐趣”。

ex.en: It is fun to play games with friends.
ex.note: fun也可作表语，后接不定式。

confuse.head: confuse
confuse.forms: 原形 confuse / 第三人称单数 confuses / 过去式 confused / 过去分词 confused / 现在分词 confusing
confuse.tip: confuse sb表示“使某人糊涂”，别与confused混用。

ex.en: Don't confuse me.
ex.note: confuse是动词，直接接宾语。

ex.en: He often confuses me with my sister.
ex.zh: 他常把我和我姐姐弄混。
ex.note: confuse A with B表示“把A和B混淆”。

ex.en: The long words confused the students, so they felt confused.
ex.zh: 长单词让学生们糊涂了，所以他们感到迷惑。
ex.note: confused作表语表示人的感受。

familiar.head: familiar
familiar.forms: 比较级 more familiar / 最高级 most familiar
familiar.tip: be familiar with表示人熟悉某物，别漏with。

ex.en: This song is familiar.
ex.note: familiar作表语，表示“熟悉的”。

ex.en: I am familiar with this street.
ex.note: 人作主语时常用be familiar with。

ex.en: Her voice sounded familiar to me.
ex.zh: 她的声音听起来对我很熟悉。
ex.note: 物作主语时常用be familiar to sb。

adapt.head: adapt
adapt.forms: 原形 adapt / 第三人称单数 adapts / 过去式 adapted / 过去分词 adapted / 现在分词 adapting
adapt.tip: adapt to表示适应，adapt from表示根据……改编。

ex.en: People adapt.
ex.note: adapt是不及物动词时，后面常接to。

ex.en: He adapted to the new school quickly.
ex.note: adapt to后接环境、变化等。

ex.en: The film was adapted from a true story.
ex.zh: 这部电影是根据真实故事改编的。
ex.note: be adapted from表示“由……改编”。

host.head: host
host.forms: 原形 host / 第三人称单数 hosts / 过去式 hosted / 过去分词 hosted / 现在分词 hosting
host.tip: host作动词表示“主持”，宾语常为节目或活动。

ex.en: She hosts a show.
ex.note: host后直接接节目名称。

ex.en: He hosted the school concert last week.
ex.zh: 他上周主持了学校音乐会。
ex.note: hosted是过去式，表示过去主持。

ex.en: Our teacher will host an English party tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们老师明天将主持一场英语聚会。
ex.note: will host表示将来主持。

culture.head: culture
culture.tip: culture作“文化”讲可数，指具体文化时可加s。

ex.en: I like Chinese culture.
ex.note: culture指整体文化时常用单数。

ex.en: Different cultures have different food.
ex.zh: 不同的文化有不同的食物。
ex.note: cultures表示多种文化。

ex.en: Learning about other cultures helps us understand the world.
ex.zh: 了解其他文化帮助我们理解世界。
ex.note: Learning about...作主语，谓语用单数。

ex.en: I go home.
ex.note: go home中home是副词，不加to。

ex.en: My home is near the park.
ex.note: home作名词，前面可加my。

ex.en: Many people lost their homes in the flood.
ex.zh: 许多人在洪水中失去了家园。
ex.note: homes表示多个家，用复数。

secret.head: secret
secret.forms: 复数 secrets；比较级 more secret / 最高级 most secret
secret.tip: in secret表示“秘密地”，keep a secret表示保守秘密。

ex.en: This is a secret.
ex.note: secret作可数名词，前面加a。

ex.en: Please keep the secret for me.
ex.note: keep a/the secret表示保守秘密。

ex.en: They met in secret to talk about the plan.
ex.zh: 他们秘密见面讨论这个计划。
ex.note: in secret是固定短语，表示“秘密地”。

success.head: success
success.tip: success 是名词；succeed 是不及物动词，常用 succeed in doing。

ex.en: Success is not easy.
ex.note: success 作不可数名词，表示抽象“成功”。

ex.en: She got great success in her work.
ex.zh: 她在工作中获得了很大的成功。
ex.note: get success 表示“获得成功”，此处 success 可作可数用法。

ex.en: He succeeded in passing the exam and became successful.
ex.zh: 他成功通过了考试，并变得很成功。
ex.note: succeed in doing 是固定搭配；successful 作形容词。

full.head: full
full.tip: full 常搭配 be full of，表示“充满……”。

ex.en: The cup is full.
ex.note: full 作形容词，表示“满的”。

ex.en: The bus is full of people.
ex.note: be full of 是常见搭配，表示“充满”。

ex.en: We should fully understand the problem before we make a full plan.
ex.zh: 在制定完整计划之前，我们应该充分理解这个问题。
ex.note: fully 修饰动词；full 修饰名词 plan。

regular.head: regular
regular.forms: more regular, most regular；regularly（副词）；irregular（形容词）
regular.tip: regular 指“有规律的”；irregular 是反义词。

ex.en: This is a regular class.
ex.note: regular 作形容词，表示“通常的，常规的”。

ex.en: He takes regular exercise every day.
ex.zh: 他每天进行有规律的锻炼。
ex.note: regular 修饰名词 exercise，表示“规律的”。

ex.en: She regularly checks her email, but today's timetable is irregular.
ex.zh: 她定期查看电子邮件，但今天的日程不规律。
ex.note: regularly 是副词；irregular 表示“不规律的”。

mental.head: mental
mental.tip: mental 常修饰 health、problem 等，指“精神的”。

ex.en: Mental health is important.
ex.note: mental 作形容词，修饰名词 health。

ex.en: Exercise is good for your mental health.
ex.zh: 运动对你的心理健康有好处。
ex.note: mental health 是常见搭配。

ex.en: He is mentally strong, so he can face mental problems calmly.
ex.zh: 他精神上很坚强，所以能冷静面对心理问题。
ex.note: mentally 是副词；mental 修饰 problems。

especial.head: especial
especial.tip: especially 更常用，表示“尤其”，常放在所强调内容前。

ex.en: This is an especial day.
ex.note: especial 作形容词，表示“特别的”。

ex.en: I like fruit, especially apples.
ex.zh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
ex.note: especially 常用来强调后面的内容。

ex.en: The weather is especial today, and it is especially good for a picnic.
ex.zh: 今天天气很特别，尤其适合野餐。
ex.note: especial 作形容词；especially 修饰 good。

sensational.head: sensational
sensational.forms: more sensational, most sensational；senseless（形容词）；sensitive（形容词）
sensational.tip: sensational 指“轰动的”；sensitive 指“敏感的”。

ex.en: The news is sensational.
ex.note: sensational 作形容词，表示“轰动的”。

ex.en: She is sensitive to other people's feelings.
ex.zh: 她对别人的感受很敏感。
ex.note: sensitive 常搭配 be sensitive to。

ex.en: The sensational story made people excited, but it was senseless to spread it.
ex.zh: 这个轰动的故事让人们很兴奋，但传播它是没有意义的。
ex.note: sensational 修饰 story；senseless 表示“无意义的”。

nature.head: nature
nature.tip: nature 指“大自然”；natural 是形容词“自然的”。

ex.en: We love nature.
ex.note: nature 作名词，表示“大自然”。

ex.en: We should enjoy the beauty of nature.
ex.zh: 我们应该享受大自然之美。
ex.note: the beauty of nature 是常见搭配。

ex.en: It is natural to protect nature because we all need it.
ex.zh: 保护大自然是理所当然的，因为我们都需要它。
ex.note: natural 作形容词；nature 作名词。

faith.head: faith
faith.tip: faith 是名词“信任”；faithful 是形容词“忠诚的”。

ex.en: I have faith in you.
ex.note: have faith in 是固定搭配，表示“信任”。

ex.en: A dog is often faithful to its owner.
ex.note: faithful 作形容词，常搭配 be faithful to。

ex.en: She kept her faith in her friend because he was always faithful.
ex.zh: 她一直信任她的朋友，因为他总是很忠诚。
ex.note: faith 作名词；faithful 作形容词。

advice.head: advice
advice.forms: 不可数名词，无复数形式；动词原形 advise / 第三人称单数 advises / 过去式 advised / 过去分词 advised / 现在分词 advising
advice.tip: advice 不可数，不能说 an advice；动词是 advise。

ex.en: Let me give you some advice.
ex.note: advice 不可数，用 some 修饰。

ex.en: My teacher often gives me useful advice.
ex.zh: 我的老师经常给我有用的建议。
ex.note: advice 前可用 useful 等形容词。

ex.en: He advised me to take more exercise, so I followed his advice.
ex.zh: 他建议我多锻炼，所以我听从了他的建议。
ex.note: advise sb to do sth；advice 作名词。

likely.head: likely
likely.forms: 比较级 more likely / most likely；反义词 unlikely，比较级 more unlikely / most unlikely
likely.tip: be likely to do sth，主语常为人或 it。

ex.en: She is likely to come.
ex.note: be likely to do 表示很可能。

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.note: it 作形式主语，后接 to do。

ex.en: Students who work hard are more likely to succeed, and it is unlikely that lazy ones will.
ex.zh: 努力的学生更可能成功，而懒惰的学生则不大可能。
ex.note: 比较级 more likely；unlikely 表否定。

magic.head: magic
magic.forms: 名词不可数，无复数形式；形容词 magical，副词 magically
magic.tip: magic 多作名词或定语；magical 强调神奇。

ex.en: I like magic.
ex.note: magic 作名词，不可数。

ex.en: The magician performed a magic trick for us.
ex.zh: 魔术师为我们表演了一个魔术。
ex.note: magic 作定语修饰 trick。

ex.en: The forest looked magical, and the lights shone magically in the dark.
ex.zh: 森林看起来充满魔力，灯光在黑暗中神奇地闪烁。
ex.note: magical 作表语；magically 修饰动词。

serve.head: serve
serve.forms: 动词原形 serve / 第三人称单数 serves / 过去式 served / 过去分词 served / 现在分词 serving；名词 service，servant
serve.tip: serve sb 服务某人；service 多不可数。

ex.en: He serves in a restaurant.
ex.note: serve 表示服务、供职。

ex.en: The waiter served us tea and cake.
ex.zh: 服务员给我们端上茶和蛋糕。
ex.note: serve sb sth 招待某人某物。

ex.en: This hotel has served guests for many years, and its service is very good.
ex.zh: 这家酒店多年来一直招待客人，它的服务非常好。
ex.note: 现在完成时 served；service 作名词。

care.head: care
care.forms: 动词原形 care / 第三人称单数 cares / 过去式 cared / 过去分词 cared / 现在分词 caring；形容词 careful，副词 carefully，形容词 careless
care.tip: care about 关心；care for 照顾；careful 后常接 of。

ex.en: I care about you.
ex.note: care about 表示关心某人。

ex.en: She cares for her old grandparents at home.
ex.zh: 她在家照顾年老的祖父母。
ex.note: care for 表示照顾。

ex.en: Be careful with your homework and write carefully, or you will make careless mistakes.
ex.zh: 做作业要细心，写字要仔细，否则会犯粗心的错误。
ex.note: careful 作表语；carefully 修饰动词。

short.head: short
short.forms: 形容词比较级 shorter / 最短 shortest；动词 shorten，名词 shortage，副词 shortly
short.tip: be short of 缺少；shortly 意为不久。

ex.en: This ruler is short.
ex.note: short 作形容词，表示短的。

ex.en: We are short of water in summer.
ex.note: be short of 表示缺少。

ex.en: The meeting will begin shortly, so we must shorten our talk because of the time shortage.
ex.zh: 会议不久就要开始，所以因时间短缺我们必须缩短谈话。
ex.note: shortly 不久；shorten 缩短；shortage 短缺。

free.head: free
free.forms: 形容词比较级 freer / 最高级 freest；名词 freedom，不可数
free.tip: be free 有空/免费；free 后常接 to do。

ex.en: Are you free now?
ex.note: free 表示有空的。

ex.en: The concert is free for students.
ex.note: free 表示免费的。

ex.en: You are free to choose your own way, but remember that freedom has limits.
ex.zh: 你可以自由选择自己的方式，但记住自由是有限度的。
ex.note: be free to do；freedom 作名词。

lay.head: lay
lay.forms: 动词原形 lay / 第三人称单数 lays / 过去式 laid / 过去分词 laid / 现在分词 laying
lay.tip: lay 过去式、过去分词都是 laid；勿与 lie 混淆。

ex.en: The hen lays an egg.
ex.note: lay 表示下蛋，第三人称单数 lays。

ex.en: She laid the book on the desk.
ex.note: 过去式 laid；lay sth on 放置。

ex.en: The worker has laid the new carpet, and the hen is laying eggs outside.
ex.zh: 工人已经铺好了新地毯，母鸡正在外面下蛋。
ex.note: 现在完成时 laid；laying 为现在分词。

addition.head: addition
addition.tip: in addition 表递进；in addition to 后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Two plus three is an addition.
ex.note: 最基础用法，指加法运算。

ex.en: In addition, we need more chairs.
ex.zh: 此外，我们还需要更多椅子。
ex.note: in addition 作连接词，需逗号隔开。

ex.en: In addition to English, she studies French.
ex.note: in addition to 后接名词或动名词。
